Privacy Policy

I believe your scale data should stay exactly where it belongs: with you. Here is exactly how I handle your information.

No Accounts

I don't ask for your name, email, or any personal details to use the tools.

Local Storage

All calculator data is generated from validated JSON files and stays in your browser session.

No Tracking

This site runs entirely clean without any analytic trackers, banners, or cookies.

1. Information I Collect & How It's Handled

When you use the calculator engines, everything runs locally on your machine. I don't track or monitor your usage layout.

Website Forms: If you drop a scaling issue, feature request, or update suggestion using the two forms on this site, that information is sent to a spreadsheet on Google Sheets and backed up on my secure, two-factor authenticated Google Drive. These forms are set up so they do not collect or store any names, email addresses, or personal information. I keep this raw community input around only for the duration of processing and adjusting the conversion numbers, after which it is deleted.

Direct Emails: If you choose to send me a direct email, your name and the text within your message will land on my email host's secure servers at Proton Mail in Switzerland. Because I run this project entirely alone, I am the only person who will ever see or read your message. I keep your email active strictly while looking into your query or scaling issue. As soon as the matter is completely resolved, your email and its contents are permanently deleted.

2. Cookies and Storage

STLACCESS is completely cookie-free. The only type of browser storage running behind the scenes is:

  • LocalStorage: This lets the site remember your custom entries in the "My Library" feature. This data remains on your hardware, meaning it's completely locked away from me or anyone else.

3. Your Data Control

Because I don't keep your personal information on any server database, you have complete control over your history:

  • Portability: You can see your active numbers directly inside your "My Library" tab.
  • Wiping Info: You can completely clear your saved numbers instantly by clicking "Clear All" in your layout panel or by wiping your local browser site cache.

4. Service Providers

I use a couple of trusted systems to keep the site functional:

  • Cloudflare: For secure deployment, caching speeds, and network security.
  • Google Workspace & Proton Mail: For parsing anonymous form reports and reading direct support requests securely.

5. Drop Me a Line

If you have an issue with privacy setups or want to check how an edge layout works, feel free to open a ticket directly on the GitHub repository. For generic use rules, check out the Terms of Service.
